title: Spell
description: A scored word game that graphs each run against the average and keeps records, with its word list and record file.
versionOrder: Disk saves have no recorded order or dates beyond their source comments. Any ordering here is a presentation guess.

versions.label: SPELL.BAS (More Voice)
versions.note: Reads WORDS.DAT and RECORD.DAT, which are kept with the first version here.
versions.unavailableReason: Preserved as source. It is not offered as a player.
versions.startupSource:
1 CLEAR 9000:DEFINT B-Z
2 CLS :PRINT "LOADING"
3 DEF FNY(X)=INT(X/120*30)
4 DEF FNS(R,W,T)= ((W/T)*(R/W)*(1-(W/T))+(R/W)*(W/T)+ATN((W+W)*(W+W)/1E4)/10)*100
5 DEF FNV(W,T)=(T-W)/(T+5)*16000
7 FORX=1TO 5:READY,Y1:P$=P$+STRING$(Y,CHR$(Y1)):NEXTX:GOTO1000
8 DATA 2,176,2,188,4,191,2,143,2,131
9 CLS:FORX=316TO950STEP58:PRINT@X,LEFT$(P$,(X-316)/58*6+4);:NEXTX:PRINT@960,RIGHT$(P$,6);
40 PRINT@704+40,"RECORD RUNS";:PRINT@768+40,"ALL-TIME  ";ER;:PRINT@832+40,"TODAY     ";ET;:PRINT@896+40,"CURRENT   ";0;
42 W=0:PA=0:TS=0:R=0:EC=0
45 FOR Y1 = 0 TO 1:SET(RR,43-(FNY(RR)+Y1)):NEXT Y1:RESET(AV,46-FNY(AV)):FOR Y1=0TO1:SET(RT,43-(FNY(RT)+Y1)):NEXTY1
50 W=W+1:GOSUB 2000
